page: Microsoft Azure E32ds_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the Edsv6 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 16 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8573C x86_64 processor operating at 4.2 GHz. The system is equipped with 256.0 GB of RAM, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. Storage is supported by 1890 GB of local disk space, and the instance is Premium Storage capable.

In benchmark evaluations, the E32ds_v6 demonstrates strong memory and processing capabilities. It achieves strong performance in large-block read-only memory bandwidth at 208.86 GB/sec and single-threaded gzip compression at 31.38 GB/sec. Geekbench scores are strong in both single-core (2120.0) and multi-core (17689.0) metrics, alongside strong results in image and text processing. Notably, the processor's advanced instruction sets, including AVX-512 and AMX (Advanced Matrix Extensions), contribute to top-tier text generation speeds of 373.84 tokens/sec for small LLM models, and strong prompt processing speeds across small and medium models.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the E32ds_v6 offers a high-density memory profile paired with dedicated compute resources and local storage, making it a viable option for memory-intensive workloads without requiring expensive GPU hardware. This server is highly suited for relational databases, in-memory caching systems, data analytics, enterprise applications, and CPU-based machine learning inference.
